_note: Preset formations. Each slot = position group + side (L/C/R). Slot order is the display order in the Tactics table (GK first). mvp=true ships in the MVP; the rest are defined for later.

defaultFormation._note: At league creation each club gets a seeded default formation drawn from the mvp presets with these weights. Its squad is generated around it, it is saved as the club's starting tactics, and the club's strength (clubs_2026_27.json) is measured in it.

sliders._note: Each slider has 5 steps: -2, -1, 0, +1, +2. 0 is neutral. Team ratings update live as sliders move.

mentality.effect: Raises Attack and lowers Defence; more shots for and against.

pressing.effect: Raises Pressing; increases energy drain, fouls, and exposure to long balls and fast forwards.

directness.effect: Short leans on short passing and dribbling (more possession); direct leans on long passing, speed and heading (quicker chances, more turnovers).

teamRatings._note: Computed from the starting XI by slot, with slider effects applied. Engine matchups: build-up = Passing vs Pressing; progression = Passing vs Defence; chance creation = Attack vs Defence; shot outcome = Attack vs Goalkeeping; crosses and set pieces = Aerial + Set Pieces vs Aerial.
teamRatings.passing: spa, lpa, drb across the XI, weighted toward CB, DM, CM
teamRatings.attack: oiq, drb, crs, spa, fin, lsh, hdr across AM, W, ST, WB, WM
teamRatings.pressing: wrk, spd, end, ant across the front six
teamRatings.defence: tkl, diq, ant, str across the back line and DM
teamRatings.aerial: hgt, jmp, hdr across the XI
teamRatings.setPieces: the designated set-piece taker's delivery quality (stp) only; aerial ability counts once in the set-piece matchup, via the aerial rating

substitutions._note: Real rule (confirmed by T, M2 planning): up to 5 subs in normal time in at most 3 windows during play; half-time subs don't use a window. Extra time adds 1 sub and 1 window; subs just before extra time and at its half-time don't use a window. No replacement once subs or windows are used up.
